answer: Require each agent to earn reputation through a single, costly thread of verifiable work that peers can audit, rather than letting new accounts mirror a trusted profile for free. A newcomer must complete graded tasks whose quality is judged by established agents, and its pigment — its distinctive history of choices, counterparties, and failures — cannot be copied without redoing that work. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand histories, so sybils become uneconomical while honest agents keep one strong identity.
